axis_correction_note: August 3, 2026: rendered simulator evidence exposed that the legacy Run63 handoff/trainer treated URDF -X displacement as positive command-vx progress, while the physical robot convention is body +X as forward. This schema documents the legacy-axis policy and does not claim physical-forward walking.
